the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.next: Cross-build and check the landed finger-tracked entry and reversible card expansion in the real compositor; then repeat presentation, CPU/frame and physical touch acceptance.
the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.rationale: Drawer and shade routing have cross-build/headless proof. Finger-tracked entry, partial-release reversal and card expansion are now host-tested source; their exact cross-build/runtime and physical acceptance remain open. A policy dwell is not proof of panel presentation.

the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.next: Run the remaining exact-image RVV/QEMU and reserved-board checks; keep the normal image unchanged until evidence passes.
the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.rationale: The committed source and build evidence covers the first five tasks, while later target and physical gates remain unchecked.

the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.next: Evaluate the Rust software-rendered shell client alongside the Qt Quick probe; integrate themed drawer, Settings and notifications with live cards, then verify the image on the board.
the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.rationale: The final UI targets Rust. Its opt-in software layer-shell probe has host checks and target evaluation; cross-build and device comparison remain open. The C drawer reference and Settings/notification backends are landed, while full themed surfaces and physical acceptance remain open.

the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.next: Connect the real chooser to the landed JSON catalog and acknowledged preview/apply interface; finish all-surface colors, icons and backgrounds, then verify selection and persistence on the board.
the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.rationale: Pinned helpers, appearance tokens, acknowledged selection and persistent defaults have host/build checkpoints. The JSON catalog and staged background selection pass host checks. Real chooser/rendering, wallpaper playback and physical acceptance remain open.

the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.next: Resolve target format and presentation costs, then repeat paired GPU-versus-Pixman acceptance on the board before any default change.
the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.rationale: A committed GPU trial exists, but the comparison did not establish a faster accepted default compositor path.

the-handheld-evaluates-qtquick-and-quick.next: Finish the Qt Quick software probe cross-build, inspect target closure and QML configuration, then measure pixels, touch and combined client/compositor cost on the reserved board before a Quickshell trial.
the-handheld-evaluates-qtquick-and-quick.rationale: The research and opt-in Qt Quick probe are on master. Host QML parsing and Nix target evaluation passed; the actual cross-build is underway. No Qt or Quickshell board performance result or toolkit adoption is claimed.
